info.name: Arch Client Accounts Investing Entities API
Get all investing entities accessible to the user

params.name: accountIds
params.description: Will filter the output to only include holdings relevant to one of the account ids in the provided argument

items.docs: Returns a list of all investing entities available to the user determined by the access token.

info.name: Add a new investing entity to Arch

items.docs: Creates a new investing entity and returns the URL, if successful.

info.name: Get info about one investing entity

params.name: id
params.description: A specific investing entity to query

items.docs: Returns details about a single investing entity.

info.name: Get data for a set of holdings under an investing entity

params.name: id
params.description: A specific investing entity to query holdings for

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of holdings to return

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of holdings to skip before collecting results

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of holdings data under an investing entity.
